National S.T.E.M. Day

images.alt:
National STEM Day is celebrated annually on November 8th to recognize the importance of science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) education and their impact on society. STEM fields play a crucial role in shaping our world and are essential tor solving complex problems and advancing innovation in many industries.
The goal of National STEM Day is to inspire and encourage students to pursue careers in
STEM fields and to support the development of STEM education programs in schools and communities. The day is also an opportunity to showcase the many exciting and rewarding opportunities available in STEM careers and to highlight the achievements of individuals and organizations in these fields.
Many events and activities are held on National STEM Day, such as science fairs, robotics competitions, coding workshops, and hands-on STEM projects. Students, teachers, and STEM professionals
participate in these events to promote STEM education and to encourage students to pursue careers in these fields.
